summary.primary_issue: Lookalike audiences 100% nested, retargeting audiences not excluded from each other, prospecting hitting retargeting users

critical_overlap_pairs.diagnosis: LAL 1% is completely contained within LAL 2%. Every dollar spent on LAL 2% competes with LAL 1% for the same users. You're bidding against yourself in every auction for the 2.4M users in the 1% audience.

impact.attribution_confusion: Conversions from 1% users may be attributed to 2% campaign

critical_overlap_pairs.recommendation: STOP running both. Options: (A) Run only 1% LAL, or (B) Exclude 1% from 2% campaign

critical_overlap_pairs.diagnosis: Both lookalikes sourced from similar seed lists (purchasers vs high-value purchasers). High-value customers are purchasers, so LALs overlap significantly. 68% of users are in both audiences.
critical_overlap_pairs.recommendation: Consolidate into single LAL from high-value customers (better seed), or exclude LAL 1% from High Value campaign

critical_overlap_pairs.diagnosis: Cart abandoners ⊂ Product viewers ⊂ Website visitors. Without exclusions, a cart abandoner sees ads from ALL THREE retargeting ad sets. This explains frequency of 8.4.
critical_overlap_pairs.recommendation: Implement exclusion hierarchy: Exclude cart abandoners from product viewers, exclude product viewers from website visitors

critical_overlap_pairs.diagnosis: Retargeting audiences are NOT excluded from prospecting campaigns. Your 180K website visitors can see both prospecting AND retargeting ads.

impact.message_confusion: Users see awareness + conversion messaging simultaneously
impact.attribution: Prospecting may get credit for retargeting conversions

critical_overlap_pairs.recommendation: Exclude all retargeting custom audiences from all prospecting campaigns
